title: Sharp Quadratic Bounds for Anticanonical Volumes of Weak Fano Surfaces
summary: We prove an explicit lower bound of optimal quadratic order for the anticanonical volume of every complex $ε$-log canonical weak del Pezzo surface, with no restriction on its Picard number or its singularities. More precisely, the volume is at least $\min\{c_{exc},ε^2/3032064\}$, where $c_{exc}>0$ is an explicit absolute constant. Quotients of the projective plane show that the exponent two is optimal.
